data_state: Before S1 primary measurements. The final A2 health gate passed all 30 new processes. S0 semantics stopped after 18 successful probes and one nondefault candidate execution failure; the remaining 45 fixed probes have not been replaced or expanded.
original_rule: research_design.json preflight.failure already preserves candidate-specific illegal/resource/numerical failures in the complete attempt ledger, while default, reference, graph-serialization, describe-equivalence and trace failures stop the affected stage.

trigger.reported_failure: CUDA illegal memory access after successful initialization, before graph construction
trigger.observed_controls: The same-workload default and ordinary a128_r4_l1_np1 zero probes passed. Root reports clean per-process GPU guard checks, two NVRTC compiles/two module loads and matching precompile/postinitialize canonical descriptions for the failed candidate.
trigger.evidence_policy: Preserve the original failed row and guard log. Save exact hashes and independently audited diagnostic outcomes in a separate decision record; do not alter this prediagnostic plan after seeing those outcomes.

bounded_diagnostic.settings: Use the original failing semantic probe's exact input seed, R=16, one sample, warmup count=0 and warmup_ms=0. Preserve FP32 C2C forward, natural output order, separate immutable input/output buffers and the frozen correctness thresholds.
bounded_diagnostic.order: Prefer both default controls before both suspect-candidate runs. If one of these exact four diagnostics has already started, count it toward the four-process cap rather than repeating it to change order.
bounded_diagnostic.isolation: Every diagnostic is a separate fresh process/context under the unchanged UUID, memory cap and guard. Do not reuse a CUDA context after an illegal-access exception.
compare: actual request, N, batch, pattern, seed and buffer capacities
ordered generated source hashes and canonical semantic descriptors
original-header expected versus instrumented observed compiler inputs, retaining A1 observation limits
suspect candidate failure phase/message and compiler/descriptor evidence
bounded_diagnostic.excluded_use: These four processes diagnose correctness/execution eligibility only. Their times do not enter screening, confirmation, headline, model labels or cost estimators. No extra workload or candidate search is authorized.

decision_rules.matching_failure: If both default controls pass, both suspect-candidate paths fail at the same single-forward execution boundary, their request/canonical/source/expected compiler inputs match, and all guard checks are clean, classify the observed suspect workload/candidate as execution-invalid under this harness and declared task. This does not establish a timing gain.
decision_rules.attribution_limit: Matching original-header and instrumented failures argue against an instrumentation-only defect. Because both use the same harness, this alone does not prove an upstream-library bug or exclude a shared harness/configuration issue. State that limit explicitly.
decision_rules.disagreement: If either default fails, the binary paths disagree, source/canonical/compiler evidence differs, or monitoring/reference/trace/graph-serialization integrity is uncertain, stop the affected path for focused engineering diagnosis. Do not relax correctness or silently classify that discrepancy as candidate-invalid.
decision_rules.controller_fix: On the matching-failure branch, allow a separately labeled nondefault execution-invalid result after successful audited initialization and a CUDA execution fault at the single-forward boundary. Keep reference, request, identity, source/descriptor, trace, graph-serialization and default/replica failures fatal. Preserve all unavailable numerical fields as unavailable rather than fabricating correctness results.
decision_rules.no_retroactive_pass: The original failed S0 probe remains failed. Complete only the remaining 45 unique frozen semantic probes; do not rerun failed cases until they pass or substitute diagnostic rows for them.
decision_rules.semantic_gate: Record protocol completion separately from candidate validity: all 64 fixed probes accounted for, protocol_valid=true only if every failed probe is an explicitly classified candidate-local failure, all_candidates_passed=false when any candidate failed, and a full candidate_validation_failures ledger. Do not label this all-candidates-passed.
decision_rules.exact_cell_eligibility: A failed fixed semantic probe makes its exact workload_id/candidate_id ineligible for performance selection even if a later random-input execution succeeds. Still perform the original S1 request and retain its actual observed result, annotated with that preflight failure. Do not extrapolate an S0-only batch failure to other batches or remove a whole candidate column without observations.
decision_rules.complete_matrix: Retain all 36x26 S1 attempted cells. Each isolated failed candidate is recorded as invalid/unavailable and excluded from winner, alternative, global eligibility and learning targets; no zero or imputed latency, skipped-column search or post-failure candidate replacement.
decision_rules.new_faults: New nondefault CUDA single-forward execution failures with the same audited initialization/protocol integrity may be recorded as execution-invalid under the same task, without claiming their root cause is proven. A new structural/trace/reference/graph/identity discrepancy remains fatal and is not covered by this classification.

health_and_guard.distinction: A guard wrapper terminating because the controller raised its candidate-failure exception is not by itself evidence of GPU competition or a failed health comparison. Reuse the completed health gate only if the associated GPU samples and closed process intervals are clean and the new diagnostic default controls pass; retain the original target-exception/guard-abort record.
health_and_guard.admission: Require the original 30-second quiet start for each guarded diagnostic/resumed stage. A real foreign-process, memory, monitoring, default-health or negative-control failure remains governed by A2/A4's exhausted recovery budget.

research_unchanged: No correctness threshold, candidate/workload request, R, performance sampling, selection objective, S2/S3/S4 budget, inferential threshold or H4 feature rule changes. This records bounded engineering evidence and implements the frozen distinction between invalid candidates and invalid experiments.
